messages:
alex_chen: Heads-up — premerge CI is blocked. SAST flagged a transitive vuln but DAST evidence is missing because artifact decrypts are failing (403). Anyone on call?

morgan_law: Looking into it. Quick grep of logs shows keystore.decrypt 403 for service account ci-runner. Did someone rotate the KMS binding/role? @sec-oncall? :eyes:

samir: Not aware of a rotation. If it's RBAC drift we should triage fast — blocked deploy.

sec-oncall: Pulling audit logs now. sec-bot created INC-2026-0421 for this. Short-term option: ephemeral grant 'keystore.reader' to ci-runner for 1h so scans can finish. Thoughts?

irene_k: We should avoid broad ephemeral grants if possible. Can we add ci-runner to the existing binding 'scan-artifact-access' instead?

morgan_law: Logs (excerpt):
```
keystore.decrypt failed 403
principal=serviceAccount:ci-runner@redwood-infer.prod
action=decrypt
rule=iam.bindings.check
request_id=abcd-1234
```

samir: Also seeing SAST attachments empty in the ticket — confirm: artifacts never decrypted so SAST couldn't attach findings. Workaround: attach raw artifact to the incident if needed.

alex_chen: Deploy is blocked until binding is restored or we do manual triage. I'm fine with ephemeral grant if sec-oncall approves — want to minimize customer impact. :thumbsup:

sec-oncall: Approved ephemeral grant. I'll push a narrow policy change (add ci-runner to scan-artifact-access) and record the change in the audit trail. Doing the rollout now.

ci-bot: iam.patch applied to binding 'scan-artifact-access' (actor=sec-oncall). Running decrypt test...

ci-bot: decrypt test PASSED. Re-triggering SAST job: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/12345

morgan_law: Nice. @alex_chen can you confirm SAST artifacts show up in the PR? If yes we can close the incident.

alex_chen: Confirmed — SAST artifacts and DAST evidence attached to the PR. Closing INC-2026-0421. Please add a postmortem note about accidental IAM role drift and the quick fix.

sec-oncall: Adding postmortem entry. Action items: 1) Playbook tweak — alert if keystore.decrypt 403 > 3 in 5m with direct link to keystore audit; 2) Add premerge gating check to validate keystore decrypt before final approval; 3) Review IAM change approvals (narrower RBAC push process).

irene_k: I like the premerge gating check idea — would catch this earlier.

samir: +1 on gating check and also add a scanner evidence policy: require non-empty attachment or fail the merge with a clear remediation link.

alex_chen: Filed follow-ups: GH redwood-infer/sdlc#987 (premerge keystore check) and #988 (postmortem and playbook updates). Thanks all.

sec-bot: Incident INC-2026-0421 marked resolved by sec-oncall. Audit log entry id=log-2026-04-21-ef12.

ci-bot: Re-run succeeded, PR unblocked. :white_check_mark:

morgan_law: Quick retrospective: we should add a small test in CI that tries `keystore.decrypt` of a known test blob and fails early with a clear message. Saves us 10-15 min triage next time.

alex_chen: Agreed. I'll take #987. Thanks everyone.
